# GitHub Repository Files

This directory contains GitHub-native issue and pull-request forms for the public repository. Keep templates factual, focused on reproducible reports, and aligned with `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `SECURITY.md`.

Do not request or accept credentials, tokens, private repository URLs, or personal data in issue or pull-request submissions. Vulnerability reports must follow `SECURITY.md` and be sent privately to `support@vibtools.io`.
